name: agent-utilities-mcp
description: Paid utility APIs for HTML, JSON, shopping data and agent configuration, with credit-safe retries.
long_description: Connect to Agent Utilities through a local MCP adapter. Discover tools without a key; execution requires prepaid service credits. Calls start at $0.0003 and credit packs cost $5 USD. The adapter handles stable debit request IDs and recovery without automatic top-ups or card purchases. Inputs are sent to the Agent Utilities service under its data policy. Review per-call prices and approve spending in your client. Keep your account recovery credential separate from the API key.

api_key.title: Agent Utilities API key
api_key.description: Optional for discovery. Get an API key and prepaid credits at the Agent Utilities workspace. Enter only an au_live_ or au_test_ API key, never the account recovery key.
